raw:
Overall, the scene is adhering well. Rowan’s choices, speech, and inner life remain his; Rosa’s unanswered question was allowed to rest. Nell, Dev, Rosa, and Martin each act on knowledge they plausibly have, and the booking conflict is resolved by Nell rather than Rowan.

- Board staging needs a correction: the six boards were already in the auditorium. Future narration should have Rosa and Martin photograph/reposition them there, then restore them to the side wall; do not continue as if they carried them in at seven.

- Bea’s “bring the old usher photographs” line is ambiguous. If it meant the green album, it conflicts with the established fact that it is already locked in the archive workroom. Treat any future offered photographs as a separate set unless Bea explicitly clarifies otherwise. The album remains cataloguing-only: no scanning, display, or Rosa access without Bea’s further agreement.

- The Friday/Monday wording is best read as: Nell entered the booking on Friday 11 September for use at 19:00–19:40 on Monday 14 September. The scene has handled that correctly. Dev’s test has no replacement slot yet; Hana now knows tonight’s call is off, and Nell has asked for future availability.

- Minor wording drift: Rosa’s Wednesday printer deadline is her plan to send the layout, not an established demand from the printer. Keep it framed that way unless new information arises.

On resuming, the pending question naturally goes to Dev while he is still in the foyer with his equipment case. He can explain his quiet booth work and the postponed receiver test, without assuming Rowan follows upstairs, helps with equipment, or says anything further.

Keep the 19:00–19:40 board session independent. Rosa’s photos and Martin’s recollections should distinguish confident attribution from memory or uncertainty. If time advances past 19:40, honor Owen’s offered help with restoring the boards unless a visible reason changes it.

Useful live pressures, conditional on what people choose to disclose:

- Owen must answer the museum interview by Wednesday noon and has a Thursday rota conflict; only Jo knows why he may seek a change.
- Rosa’s Wednesday layout plan and Tuesday evening promise to Beth make further casual rescheduling costly.
- Bea’s consent boundary, Dev’s paid-time constraints, and Nell’s Wednesday rota deadline can create practical friction without making Rowan responsible for resolving any of it.
